ops.title: Poll-machinery E2E over an in-process Serve harness
ops.description:
Net-new coverage deferred by team-lead ruling at the v0.21 flag day (restore-what-regressed / defer-what-is-new).

Harness design (validated at design time, do not rediscover):
- Sandbox: testhome.Sandbox with a SHORT root — os.MkdirTemp("/tmp", "ccp-home") — never t.TempDir(): macOS caps sun_path at 104 bytes and daemonkit refuses longer typed (*paths.SocketPathError, paths/socket.go:5).
- Serve in-process in a goroutine: daemonkit.Serve(ctx, Spec(Program{}, nil), start); cancel+join in t.Cleanup.
- Readiness and all assertions ride the BUSINESS lane only: daemonkit Control attach refuses a pinned PID equal to os.Getpid() (control.go:136), so WaitReady/Control.Health are structurally unreachable in-process. Probe readiness by retrying Business.Call on a fixture-owned op until ErrNotReady stops.
- Tests cannot be t.Parallel (t.Setenv forbids it) — serialization is enforced.
- Run only under scripts/test.sh with the fleet test token claimed.

Spec-level pins already exist (spec_test.go concurrency arithmetic + MaxDetail pin); this task is the end-to-end exercise of internal/daemon/account_mutation_poll.go.

ops.text: 128 parked polls across 4 terminals x 32 attachments; ProvideInput/Cancel/Ack still dispatch in the 8-slot headroom
a second poll on one attachment supersedes the first, never stacks, under concurrent load
a parked poll returns within pollReplyMargin of drain-begin, not at its deadline
controller detaches on Session.Disconnected within TerminalDisconnectPolicy while a blocked handler pins the session; session state drops on Done
